headline: Apple releases iOS 27.2 with new Siri AI features and security fixes
summary: Apple rolled out iOS and macOS 27.2, adding new Siri AI features and languages, Apple Pencil and 'Edge Light' support for the iPhone Duo, dual-camera FaceTime support, tighter control over Siri's app access, and security fixes.

claims.statement: Apple released iOS and macOS 27.2 with new Siri AI features.

sources.quote: Apple releases iOS and macOS 27.2 with new Siri AI features, new Music logo
Apple adds more Siri AI tools in its 27.2 system updates, out today
Apple rolls out iOS 27.2 with new Siri AI languages and security fixes

claims.statement: The update adds Apple Pencil support for the iPhone Duo.

sources.quote: iPhone Duo now supports Apple Pencil with iOS 27.2

claims.statement: The update adds an 'Edge Light' feature for the iPhone Duo intended to illuminate faces during video calls.

sources.quote: an "Edge Light" feature for the iPhone Duo that's intended to illuminate your face during video calls.

claims.statement: The update lets users limit which applications Siri can directly access.

sources.quote: Included is the ability to limit which applications Siri can directly access.

claims.statement: The update includes dual-camera support for FaceTime.

sources.quote: offers major Siri AI upgrades, dual camera support for FaceTime

claims.statement: This is the first major update for the current iOS, following iOS 27.1.

sources.quote: iOS 27.2 is the first major update for the current OS.
